description: This Java source file defines the main activity class `AdbTestActivity` for an Android application that tests USB device communication with ADB (Android Debug Bridge). It manages USB device connections, handles device attachment/detachment events, and provides methods to interact with connected devices, including logging and claiming interfaces.

classes.name: AdbTestActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing USB connections, device detection, and ADB communication in an Android testing app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, checks for connected devices, and registers USB device attachment/detachment receivers.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by unregistering receivers and releasing resources.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Adds a log message to the activity log view.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends text to the log view, maintaining maximum number of visible lines.

methods.name: deviceOnline
methods.description: Handles a device coming online, sends message to handler.

methods.name: handleDeviceOnline
methods.description: Logs device online status and initiates a shell command socket.

methods.name: setAdbInterface
methods.description: Sets or releases the current USB device interface and connection.

methods.name: findAdbInterface
methods.description: Searches for an ADB interface on a given USB device.
